csv_project_name: CMAR for RAP Terminal Construction Concourse Project 2A
csv_scope_of_work: Rapid City Regional Airport Terminal Construction Concourse - Project 2A. This project, the proposed Rapid City Regional Airport Expansion Project, will increase airport capacity from 7 to 12 gates, address existing hold room and circulation constraints, and expand the existing airport apron. The Rapid City Regional Airport Board of Directors will use a best value competitive proposal process to select the Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) for the Airline Terminal Concourse Expansion Project. The process is designed to be transparent, competitive, and consistent with City procurement requirements, SDCL 5-18B, and applicable federal funding requirements. Proposals will be evaluated on the criteria published in this RFP, including qualifications, project approach, and the CMAR Fee Proposal.
